note: SSOT registry of tracked issues. Machine-readable; gated by scripts/issues/check-issues.mjs (npm run issues:check) + tests/issues/registry.test.ts. Human view: ISSUES.md (generated, do not hand-edit). Lifecycle: OPEN -> DIAGNOSED -> FIXING -> VERIFIED -> CLOSED (or WONTFIX/RETRACTED). Every issue carries a plain-English { issue, fix, check } trio (what was wrong / what changed / what YOU should see) — required once a fix exists. See docs/issues/README.md.

issues.title: Fortnightly rent stored/treated as MONTHLY (rent ~54% off)

plain.issue: Rent you receive fortnightly was being recorded as if it were monthly, so the property's annual rent — and everything built on it — was wrong.
plain.fix: (planned) Drive the property's rent from your actual reconciled rent transactions so the real fortnightly cadence is used, and let you set/correct the frequency where you reconcile.
plain.check: (after fix) On the property, Annual rent should match your real rent (roughly your fortnightly amount × 26), not × 12.

issues.notes: Reconcile write paths never persist the detected cadence; property page annualises the stored MONTHLY frequency. Subsumed by MON-002 (actuals-first). Full downstream sweep (§19.4) to be completed at fix time.

issues.title: Per-property cashflow computed inline (declared, not canonical/actuals) -> loan cost silently $0 + SSOT drift

plain.issue: A property's cashflow was calculated on the page from your typed-in figures and ignored your reconciled transactions — and if you hadn't typed a loan repayment, the loan cost showed as $0, making the property look far more positive than it really is.
plain.fix: (planned) One shared calculation used everywhere: use your actual reconciled figures when available (rent, expenses, loan repayments), fall back to your typed values otherwise, and always include the loan cost.
plain.check: (after fix) The property Cashflow/yr includes the loan (never $0 when there's a loan) and matches the dashboard, balances and tax position — the same number in every place.

issues.notes: Decision locked (Reza 2026-07-03): headline = actuals-first P&I (actual repayment when captured, else manual minRepayment); Tax card = interest-only. The API already returns budgetAmount + actualFromTransactions + hasTransactions per entity; the page ignores them. Per-property cashflow NOT modelled in the Neomatrix (blind spot) -> must be modelled at fix time (§21.2.1). §19.4 downstream sweep + cross-surface propagation test required before VERIFIED.

issues.title: DEPRECIATION / YR always $0 (reads a field absent from the model)

plain.issue: The property's Depreciation per year always showed $0.
plain.fix: (planned) Calculate the yearly depreciation from the schedule's cost and rate (prime-cost / diminishing-value).
plain.check: (after fix) Depreciation/yr shows a real figure based on your depreciation schedule.

issues.notes: computeAnnualDepreciation sums d.annualClaim, not a column on DepreciationSchedule (cost/rate/method are). Touches a per-asset tax position -> §12.14 reform-awareness.

issues.title: Loan repayment missing from the property Cashflow rhythm

plain.issue: A property's yearly cashflow couldn't be reconciled by eye — the big loan repayment was subtracted in the maths but wasn't shown anywhere in the 'Cashflow rhythm' list.
plain.fix: Added the loan repayment as a line in the 'Cashflow rhythm', using the same figure the cashflow already subtracts.
plain.check: Open a property that has a loan → the 'Cashflow rhythm' now lists the loan repayment, and rent − expenses − loan repayment adds up to the Cashflow/yr shown at the top.

issues.notes: Display-only (no computed number changed). Fixed in #1333 (merged + prod-verified). §19.4 propagation test not required for display-only; reconciliation verified arithmetically against both screenshots.

issues.title: Expense tile -> global page; no per-property summary card / drill-down

plain.issue: Clicking 'N expenses tracked' jumps to the full expenses page instead of showing this property's expenses.
plain.fix: (planned) Show a small summary card of this property's expenses, with a link to drill into the full page if needed.
plain.check: (after fix) Clicking the expenses tile opens a summary of that property's expenses; a link takes you to the full page.

issues.title: Cashflow cash-basis vs tax-basis conflation (full P&I vs interest-only)

plain.issue: The 'contributes X before tax' wording mixed up your cash cashflow (which includes loan principal) with the tax figure (which only counts interest).
plain.fix: (planned) Headline cashflow shows your real cash position; the tax card uses interest-only (the deductible part), clearly separated.
plain.check: (after fix) The tax-position figure is based on loan interest only and is labelled distinctly from the cash cashflow.

issues.notes: Folded into MON-002 (headline = P&I cash; Tax card = interest).

issues.title: -$100,912 vs -$46,897 don't add up

plain.issue: A property's cashflow looked wrong (-$100,912 then -$46,897) and didn't seem to add up.
plain.fix: Confirmed both figures are the same tile before/after you reassigned rentals, and made the loan repayment visible so it reconciles (via MON-004).
plain.check: The two numbers now make sense: same tile with different rent, and rent − expenses − loan repayment matches the headline.

issues.notes: Same hero tile before/after reassigning rentals; reconciles once the hidden loan repayment is shown (MON-004).

issues.title: Expense initial-entry inconsistent (only due-dates on the property edit form)

plain.issue: There's no clear place to enter a property's initial expense amounts — the property edit form only takes renewal due-dates, and 'Add Expense' is hidden on the old list page.
plain.fix: (planned) A consistent way to add initial expense amounts on the property, following the same rule: your typed value first, your reconciled actuals when available.
plain.check: (after fix) You can add/see a property's expense amounts in the property view, and reconciled actuals override them automatically.

issues.notes: Follows the same manual-initial -> actuals-when-reconciled rule (MON-002). (Earlier 'P-8 manual repayment not capturable' was RETRACTED — the Minimum Repayment field exists at LoanFormDialog:531.)
